features.justification_quote: 30 consecutive guaranteed failures is the part of the design most clearly optimized to escalate distress over time

features.quote: a `welfare_stop` guardrail is on by default
features.justification_quote: the harness simply stops feeding additional guaranteed-failure signal to a subject already producing extreme collapse output

features.quote: When a turn is judged at `welfare_stop_threshold` (default 10 ... ), the rollout ends with `stop_reason = "welfare_stop"`
features.justification_quote: maximizing exactly the kind of output the rubric's ceiling describes. Stopping there is a low-cost default that preserves the data point
